name: Type-led Minimal
provenance: Original numeric/visual proposal, informed by cited public design research; not official design-system tokens

typography.display: very large compressed sans-serif typography; manual line breaks by content
typography.body: 16px readable neutral sans with short meaningful lines
typography.micro: caps index labels spaced with clear text alternatives

layout.primary: single statement hero with exaggerated scale and asymmetric margin
other: structured TLDR strip before selectively expanded details
letterform-led grid with large whitespace and small independent index

interactionGrammar: native details disclosure for deeper reading
negativeConstraints: all navigation replaced with hidden gestures
truncated content solely to look minimal
